dz.headerUnlocked: Unlocked. Destructive operations below are irreversible.
dz.headerLocked: Destructive maintenance operations. Requires the system owner credentials to enter.
dz.enterOwner: Enter the system owner credentials to open the reset console.
dz.notOwner: You do not have permission — this account is not the system owner.
dz.historianHelp: Pause to block all new time-series writes so the bucket stays empty after a wipe (e.g. for a clean demo). Reads/queries are unaffected. Resets to Active on API restart.
dz.resetProdDesc: Permanently deletes all production orders, work orders, job orders, production events, batch records, material consumptions, scrap logs and reschedule requests from PostgreSQL. Quality inspections, maintenance orders, downtime events and SPC measurements are preserved (their production links are cleared).
dz.resetProdDanger: all production orders, work orders, job orders and their data
dz.wipeTsDesc: Permanently deletes every point in the InfluxDB bucket "{{bucket}}" (OEE, energy, tag history). Note: a running edge gateway will repopulate live data immediately — stop it first to keep the bucket empty.
dz.willDelete: This will permanently delete {{danger}}. This action cannot be undone.
dz.alsoWipeTsDesc: Clears InfluxDB high-frequency production/OEE history in the same run.

toast.historianWipedDesc: All time-series points were deleted from InfluxDB.
toast.wipeFailedDesc: InfluxDB did not confirm the delete. Check the historian connection.
toast.historianPausedDesc: New time-series writes are blocked — the bucket stays empty.
